name: com.openugd.corelib
description: The Unity boundary of the OpenUGD family: ContextBehaviour, a MonoBehaviour that boots a com.openugd.context Context and exposes the Unity loop as signals, plus a presenter tree for view composition, a command mapper for message handling, tagged logging with a Unity console sink, and coroutine and SynchronizationContext seams a test can replace.

samples.description: Several game instances in one process, one per display, with input and audio focus switched between them: the 0.6.x ContextInstanceComponent, ContextFactoryInstancesComponent and IContextInstanceProvider, moved out of the package in 2.0.0 and fixed. The scripts keep their 0.6.x GUIDs, so existing prefabs and scenes bind to them after the import.
